g.title: DocumentEditSequence
g.text: Document edit — immediate tracked-pair repair, later recognition

g.title: events3->session3
g.text: 3 documentChanged(change) for every Editor sharing Document

g.title: fallback7->active7
g.text: 7 exact current guide OR null on budget

g.title: active8->session8
g.text: 8 replace current markup OR clear stale guide

g.title: events10->document10
g.text: 10 listener returns — visible pair is revision-consistent

g.title: sequence_note
g.text: Rows 1–10 are one EDT callback: repair or clear before return.
Damaged endpoint tokens clear pair + guide and skip the fallback scan.
Rows 11–13 happen later and may discover a different semantic pair.
